subject.title: fix(agents): stop runs at the critical tool-loop threshold

question: Should the existing Codex `loopDetectionPreToolUseRelay: false` opt-out intentionally disable the new companion `PostToolUse` loop-outcome relay as this PR documents?
rationale: That setting previously described a pre-tool loop-detection subprocess; extending it to suppress the companion outcome relay changes the compatibility contract for existing opted-out Codex installations and needs owner intent rather than an automated assumption.

options.title: Confirm unified opt-out
options.body: Keep the proposed behavior and treat `false` as disabling both loop-detection-only native relays, with the updated docs and focused regression coverage.

options.title: Keep outcome relay independent
options.body: Retain the existing pre-tool opt-out meaning and introduce a separately reviewed policy only if suppressing outcome relays is required.

recommendation.title: Confirm unified opt-out
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed behavior and treat `false` as disabling both loop-detection-only native relays, with the updated docs and focused regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The contributor documented the intended switch semantics and can provide the implementation context, while an agent-runtime owner should make the final contract decision.
